The seal system is used to prevent leakage of lube oil and to protect the pump and the engine from contaminants.

The gas turbine lube oil pump also includes the lube oil pump control system, which is used to control the operation of the pump. The control system typically includes a sensor that measures the pressure or flow rate of the lube oil, and a controller that adjusts the operation of the pump based on the measured value.
